quests.title: The Chosen One
quests.about: Aira is certain she's destined for greatness, and she'll tell you so at length. There's a spirit inside her who keeps quiet most of the time, and a silver ribbon in her hair she never takes out.

endings.title: Share the secret

endings.title: Keep looking for her
endings.about: Aira goes to the old gate and finds the truth: the ribbon belonged to a girl who died in the school fire years ago. The spirit inside Aira is her mother, and Aira is the one who has to tell her.

endings.about: Aira decides not to go into the gate alone, and asks the spirit to stay quiet. She says the ribbon should go back to the old gate, where the girl last stood, and she asks you to be there when it does.

quests.title: Turbo Granny
quests.about: Okarun has forty-two clippings on Turbo Granny, and he is certain she is no yokai. He thinks the speed comes from somewhere above the sky, and nobody believes him.

endings.title: Read the clippings
endings.about: Okarun hands you the rest of the clippings, and says the granny's speed has to come from a machine. Somebody out there is building the machine, and he wants to know who.

quests.title: Golden Balls
quests.about: Turbo Granny cursed Okarun and took his golden balls, the cursed item that gives him his power. He wants them back, and Momo says she'll help only if it's a ghost. It's not.

quests.title: The Seller
quests.about: The granny's speed was bought, not born. Okarun thinks an alien trader sold it to her, and that the trader is selling the same speed to others. Cinder is one of the buyers. Okarun has to prove it, and the proof is the last clipping.

them: Meet me at the arena tonight. You'll be the witness when she tells me the seller's name, or lies about it.

endings.about: Okarun admits the curse has a ghost in it, after all. He's still certain about the aliens, but he lets Momo have the ghost, which he says is the first time he's ever lost an argument on purpose.

quests.title: The Horn

quests.about: Rem's guilt about the night of the fire, and the horn Ram lost that night. Weiss wants to fight the twins, and she's offering the player a reason to stand with Rem.

endings.title: Stop apologising
endings.about: Rem stops apologising for an afternoon. Ram pretends not to notice, and is very pleased about it.

quests.title: See Who Holds

endings.about: Rem holds onto Ram's hand, and the horn on the table stops shaking. Ram finally admits that 'barely adequate' was the kindest thing she had ever said to anyone, and the twins stay together.
